original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Qualcomm'}), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10
reference_query:
MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(:Company {companyName:'Qualcomm'})
MATCH (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(meeting:Meeting)
WITH a,max(meeting.sourceReportedEndDate) AS meetingPeriodEndDate
RETURN a.resolutionId AS resolutionId,a.content AS content,meetingPeriodEndDate
ORDER BY meetingPeriodEndDate DESC,resolutionId ASC
